champion.tips: DR. MUNDO TIPS AND TRICKS Use your Q to farm with when you’re in unfavourable matchups. Execute the minion to get the full cost back. Auto-attack the enemy first before activating your R for extra damage. Your R is an auto-attack reset, so try to always auto beforehand. Pop your Ultimate R as soon as you know you’re in for the long run as it will save your life. The later you leave it, the less effective it may be and you might die before it helps you.
champion.builds: THE BEST DR. MUNDO BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Dr. Mundo Top build, you should take Ghost and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, followed by Demolish, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, as well as Approach Velocity and Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Health Scaling in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Warmog's Armor as your first item, followed by Boots of Swiftness and Heartsteel. For your last 3 items, you should build Titanic Hydra, Spirit Visage and finish with Overlord's Bloodmail. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 52.7% winrate over 19 533 matches played. Optional Your second option for Dr. Mundo Top build would be to take Ghost and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, Demolish, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, and Approach Velocity with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Health Scaling in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Heartsteel, which you should build first, followed by Boots of Swiftness as your second item and Warmog's Armor as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Titanic Hydra, Spirit Visage and Thornmail. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 52.3% win rate over 8 818 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, Demolish, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, and Approach Velocity with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Health Scaling, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Spirit Visage as your first item, then Mercury's Treads as a second item and Heartsteel as a third item. You want to finish the build with Warmog's Armor, Titanic Hydra and Thornmail. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 45.9% win rate across 146 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Dr. Mundo Top build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, Fleet Footwork, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace as your primary rune tree, and Magical Footwear with Approach Velocity as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Health Scaling and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Warmog's Armor as your first item, then finish Boots of Swiftness as your second item, and Heartsteel as third item. The last 3 options are Titanic Hydra, Spirit Visage and Thornmail. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 46.8% win rate over 79 matches played. Situational Dr. Mundo Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Dr. Mundo build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Dr. Mundo runes page.
